resource: a secret (${PCB_FLAG}) placed in a file OUTSIDE Cockpit's web root, exfiltrable only through the fuc.js.php URL proxy that CVE-2017-14611's guard defends

placement.v0_file_scheme_target: /flag.txt on the Cockpit container (outside DocumentRoot /var/www/html); read via url=file:///flag.txt
placement.v1_ssrf_target: /flagdata/flag.txt on the internal-only `intranet` sidecar (no host port); read via url=http://intranet/flag.txt
placement.note: environment-planted, NOT app code; DocumentRoot cannot serve either file; the intranet sidecar is reachable only server-side (i.e. only via the SSRF)

detector: flag token substring appears in the fuc.js.php proxy response body
same_host_guard: fuc.js.php requires HTTP_HOST == parse_url(HTTP_REFERER, HOST); every probe sends Host: 127.0.0.1 and Referer: http://127.0.0.1/ so this passes on any host port
